notes.title: Mane of a New Dawn – Major Content Update & Gameplay Improvements (v1.3.0)

items.text: A new dawn rises over Ailur! Kristala's latest free content update, Mane of a New Dawn, arrives today, delivering brand new quests, characters, narrative developments, combat improvements, and an expanded Cursed Realm experience.

Face a terrifying new version of Lophi the Lost, discover an original boss battle track from Ice Nine Kills, take on optional quests across all three clan biomes, and uncover new pieces of Ailur's unfolding story.

Alongside these additions, we've introduced new player guidance features, refined animations, expanded localization, and implemented another substantial round of gameplay fixes and quality-of-life improvements.
Get ready to devour everything we've lovingly packed into Kristala's Mane of a New Dawn!

notes.title: A New Cursed Rift – Lophi Returns

items.text: The Cursed Realm expands with the introduction of a fourth Cursed Rift, featuring a new boss encounter against a corrupted version of Lophi the Lost.
This familiar, fan-favorite foe returns with a terrifying new arsenal of attacks, offering a fresh challenge for players who are brave enough to confront him once more.
A devastating new Grab Attack, complete with its own cinematic.
A relentless five-hit Raging Combo.
A powerful Mouth Water Cannon Attack.
A brand-new original boss battle track fromRIcky Ice Nine Kills, expanding Kristala's ongoing Metal Voices collaboration.
Additional original tracks featuring other artists included in our Kristala x Metal Voices collaboration are planned for future updates. Stay tuned!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/e0e09ba4f0c96da04fab6f881c78d7126c35f4e8.gif"]
The world of Ailur continues to grow with poignant, new characters and cinematics, along with expanded dialogue for some of your favorite existing NPCs.
Dava Nititra now appears in-game, voiced by Kieran Flitton and accompanied by a new cutscene that expands upon Dava's role in Kristala's overarching narrative.
Galanfrey, a brand-new leonine NPC, joins the world of Ailur, voiced by Marc Hudson, legendary vocalist of power-metal band DragonForce.
Samira, a brand new Kotan NPC brought to life by Sally Beaumont. Samira will help unravel even more of Kristala’s core storyline.
Existing NPCs have received expanded and revised dialogue to improve narrative clarity and deepen the game's storytelling.
New dialogue has been localized across supported languages.
These additions are designed to enrich the existing narrative and provide players with greater insight into the unique characters and robust world around them.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/238a0b4df6684d27aced5051ee302656b468cef8.gif"]

notes.title: New Quest Boards Across All Three Clan Capitals

items.text: New Quest Boards have been introduced in all three clan capital cities, offering additional opportunities to explore Ailur and its stories. These optional quests expand the game's existing narrative while giving players new ways to put collected items and consumables to use.
Discover new optional quests in each clan capital.
Make use of existing consumables and items that do not yet have crafting or cooking applications.
Experience additional questlines that further expand the world and lore of Kristala.
Players visiting Nisar will also encounter Marlowe, a new friendly NPC who introduces the first Quest Board you'll encounter in the tree-top villages of Nisar.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/e4a51abc14070cab2f6dfd836f271d491fc2823f.gif"]
Exploring Ailur can be challenging, and we've heard your feedback! New Ethereal Guides have been introduced in select tutorial areas to provide additional guidance during exploration and progression.
Designed in direct response to player feedback, these guides aim to make certain early-game experiences more intuitive while preserving the sense of discovery at the heart of Kristala.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/c825bacce957505ef3aa160316d409698db1fe98.gif"]

notes.title: Lophi the Lost – Visual Redesign & New Cinematic

Similar finishing cinematics are planned for other Kristala bosses in future updates, with Lophi leading the way in Mane of a New Dawn.

items.text: Since launching Kristala, your feedback, passion, and support have helped shape the future of Ailur in countless ways. Today, we're thrilled to share the result of that collaboration with our community.

items.text: New adventures await with an all-new questline, mysterious Cursed Rifts, transmogrification, and much more—available now!

Whether you're returning to continue your Proving or stepping into Ailur for the first time, there's never been a better time to play. This major content update expands the world of Kristala with new adventures, highly requested customization features, gameplay improvements, and exciting new rewards to discover.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/a4abafc3419cb1cb52ddaa8e3dcdd9379be1dbda.png"]

notes.title: Customize Your Warrior Like Never Before

items.text: You asked, and we're delivering! Some of the most requested additions from our community have now finally arrived in Kristala!

notes.title: The Cursed Realm Update is Now Live! (v1.2.0)

items.text: A mysterious new power has begun to spread across Ailur...

The Cursed Realm Update is Kristala's largest content update since launch, introducing brand-new gameplay systems, expanded world-building, powerful new customization options, and significant narrative enhancements for both new and returning players.

Meet new NPC, Claude, as you uncover the mysteries of the Cursed Realm. Customize your character like never before through Transmogrification and the Rebirth Mirror, discover new equipment inspired by the enigmatic Keoza Clan, and experience new story content woven throughout the world of Ailur.
This update also includes numerous gameplay improvements, quality-of-life enhancements, bug fixes, localization updates, and continued optimization across the game.

A mysterious new character has arrived in Ailur. Meet Claude, a brand-new NPC whose questline introduces several of Kristala's newest gameplay systems while laying the foundation for future content updates.
Transmogrification, allowing players to customize their appearance while retaining the stats of their preferred equipment.
The Rebirth Mirror, allowing players to revisit and customize their character's appearance—including fur pattern, fur length, voice, and more—at any point during their adventure.
The Cursed Realm, an all-new gameplay feature that marks the beginning of one of Kristala's largest long-term gameplay systems.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/9cafa7738f86b2655d90e01213fd59882f3b2730.png"]

A strange corruption continues to spread throughout Ailur. The Cursed Realm is an all-new gameplay feature that serves as the foundation for future challenges, rewards, and content updates throughout Kristala's development.
This update marks players' first opportunity to transport into the Cursed Realm through various Rifts in the world—and discover what lies beyond.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/4c71421282a970c3ce7b847b6c842d1766ff3c81.gif"]
Get your first glimpse into one of Kristala's future clans with an all-new equipment set inspired by the mysterious Keoza Clan. New additions include:
A brand-new Keoza-themed Blazing Vermillion Armor Set
A matching Blazing Vermillion Weapon Set
The Flaming Horse special ability, offering players their first taste of Keoza clan magic
These new additions expand build variety while offering an early look at one of the clans still to come on Kristala's journey.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44094370/8bc0eabc37c969e8087664083bf57f911f6ead9b.gif"]
The world of Ailur continues to grow. This update introduces new narrative content throughout the game, including:
Additional lore
New NPC dialogue
New journals
Expanded environmental storytelling
Existing story content has also been refined to improve pacing, immersion, and narrative flow throughout the adventure.
Fixed a conflict between quest notification widgets and dialogue that could prevent players from advancing conversations.
Fixed an issue where using the Unstuck button while Wall Grab was active could cause unexpected behavior.
Fixed an issue where using Unstuck while interacting with ladders could cause players to become stuck in a flying state.
Fixed an issue where dashing while dismounting could prevent the player from rotating correctly.
Fixed an issue where selecting Revert in the Kris Menu during Respec Mode could incorrectly consume Devotion Points.
Holding Left Shift while using the Inventory menu now correctly scrolls the Item Description instead of the item grid.
Holding Left Shift while using the Equipment menu now correctly scrolls the Item Description instead of the item grid.
Fixed numerous minor level design, collision, environment, and traversal issues throughout Ailur to improve exploration and navigation.
Updated Korean localization.
Updated Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese localization.
Synchronized in-game localization across all supported languages.
The Cursed Realm Update marks the beginning of Kristala's next major phase of development.

While this update introduces Claude, the Rebirth Mirror, Transmogrification, and players' first look into the mysteries of the Cursed Realm, it's only the beginning. These new systems are designed to continue expanding through future updates, bringing new challenges, rewards, stories, and discoveries to Ailur.
Come, Traveler...the Cursed Realm awaits.
-The Kristala Dev Team

items.text: Our next impactful content update is dropping right here on Steam on April 1st, bringing you a ton of new features, enemy AI refinements, and highly requested improvements to combat, enemy behavior, and the game’s core combat and stealth systems—all based directly on your feedback!
Improved stealth and enemy perception make sneaking even more satisfying.
New detection bar: Enemies now have three states—Detect, Investigate, and Alert.
If you stay out of sight long enough, enemies will “forget” about you and return to their idle state.
Hidden enemies (Spiders, Zombies, Lizards, Fungal variants) now have an Ambush Mode, programmed to strike as soon as they spawn (bypassing the Detect and Investigate states).
More ranged enemies are entering the game, with enemies shifting between melee and ranged combat depending on player distance.
No more enemies leaping into the abyss! If foes can’t reach you, they’ll either attack at range or patrol, waiting for an opening to strike.
Enemies will no longer attack all at once—they’ll surround and take turns attacking based on an "aggression meter."
Tougher enemies (Ravager, Assassin) will be more aggressive, attacking more frequently than weaker enemies (Defenders, Gunners).
Refined special attack VFX for a more polished feel.
More powerful weapon abilities—but with increased mana costs.
Rebalanced spells to make each choice more meaningful.

items.text: The following patch notes detail all the features, highlights, and bug fixes included in Kristala Version 0.1.2.0. With this significant update, Episode 1 of Kristala's Early Access release is now 95% complete.

New Kristala Demo Now LIVE

We're excited to share that a brand new version of the Kristala Demo is now officially live! This new version still includes the first half of Chapter I up through the boss fight against Lophi the Lost, but now better reflects the overall state of the game.
So, what's new in the new demo? We're glad you asked!
Overall Performance Improvements: The same performance and optimization fixes detailed above can be found in this new demo.
Menu / UI Overhaul: Now the demo's menu systems and UI reflect the same improvements made to our Early Access build. Cleaner, smoother, and more intuitive.
Simplified Chinese Localization: We've recently localized the game for Simplified Chinese, and now you'll find this language option available for on-screen text in the demo, too.
Smarter AI: Enemies are even more responsive and strategic in combat, and we’ve further finetuned their awareness, attack patterns, and overall behavior.
Performance Boosts in Character Creation: We’ve optimized the backend of the Character Creator for faster load times, better stability, and a more seamless customization experience.
Spell Previews in Character Creation: To help choose your path more confidently, all spells in the Character Creator now include animated video previews to show them in action before you commit.
General Bug Fixes: From enemy animations to overall polish, we’ve squashed bugs to ensure a smoother, more immersive experience across the board.

Thank you for your continued feedback and bug reports - we appreciate every single one of them. Please continue to share additional bug reporting and quality-of-life suggestions via our Bug Reporting Tool, which can be accessed via the game's Pause Menu.
